title: The Drownlight - The Lantern Room
_note: Drownlight family rung 3 (drownlight_lantern): the darkest. The hymn in FRAGMENTS — the first bar of each phrase on low strings, the rest left as silence — over a drone that rocks between a bare fifth and a held minor second (D/E-flat). One high bell every four bars is the thread of light at the shutters' seam; the clockwork ticks once a bar. 66 BPM. It never resolves: the last bar hangs on the dominant.
